String: [TBD] Next
[TBD] Next
[TBD] You cannot go there. Pick a green tile.
[TBD] When an explanation ends, press [Next] to continue.
[TBD] When there is something to click, it will be lit up.
[TBD] At night, monsters pour from the portals to the castle.
[TBD] If the castle falls it is over. Block their path by day.
[TBD] Press the BUILD MODE button to open the build panel.
[TBD] Open the TOWER tab to see what you can build.
[TBD] Pick the ARROW tower. The numbers on each entry are its build cost.
[TBD] Click a green tile to raise the tower.
[TBD] Pick one more tower. A single tower rarely survives the night.
[TBD] Place the second tower on a green tile as well.
[TBD] Press ESC, or the BUILD MODE button again, to close the build panel.
[TBD] Click the tower you just built.
[TBD] Press +1 ASSIGN to staff this tower with one worker.
[TBD] The closer to full staff, the higher the operation rate.
[TBD] It raises damage and range. Unstaffed towers do not fire.
[TBD] Press -1 UNASSIGN to pull one worker back.
[TBD] Press ALL ASSIGN to fill this tower to capacity at once.
[TBD] ALL UNASSIGN pulls every worker back at once.
[TBD] Press CLOSE to close the staffing panel.
[TBD] Click the other tower, the one you left unstaffed.
[TBD] Press BUILD MODE to open the build panel. Demolishing is done from here.
[TBD] Note your resources above before you demolish.
[TBD] Press REMOVE, then click the tower you want to tear down.
[TBD] Your resources came back. Same-day demolition refunds all.
[TBD] After a day only 70% returns. Fix mistakes before it ends.
[TBD] Open the BUILDING tab.
[TBD] Pick the research lab.
[TBD] Click a green tile to build the lab.
[TBD] Click the lab you just built.
[TBD] Press +1 ASSIGN to staff the lab.
[TBD] Lab workers bring research points at the end of each night.
[TBD] An unstaffed lab earns nothing at all.
[TBD] You spend research points through the RESEARCH button.
[TBD] You have none today. Come back tomorrow morning.
[TBD] Your people eat every day. Food comes from farms.
[TBD] Run out and your people leave, idling towers and workshops.
[TBD] Open the FACTORY tab.
[TBD] Pick FARM FIELD.
[TBD] Click a green tile to build the farm.
[TBD] Click the farm you just built.
[TBD] Press +1 ASSIGN to staff the farm.
[TBD] Production scales with the workers you assign.
[TBD] How you split them decides each day's output.
[TBD] Press CLOSE to close the staffing panel.
[TBD] Press the CLAIM button to open claim mode.
[TBD] Yellow marks your land, green is what you can claim.
[TBD] Red is out of reach. Claims spread only from your land.
[TBD] The figures show added population and resources.
[TBD] Choose a tile to claim and click it.
[TBD] DURATION is how many days the expedition needs.
[TBD] Land marked MONSTER strengthens the monsters you face.
[TBD] Weigh what you gain against what you must hold off.
[TBD] COST TO CONQUER is the price. Scroll it sideways.
[TBD] Press CLAIM to send the expedition.
[TBD] Land being claimed is outlined in grey.
[TBD] Survive that night and it is yours. Lose and it is void.
[TBD] Press ESC, or the CLAIM button again, to leave claim mode.
[TBD] A dragon's blessing has come to you. You have received a Life dragon egg.
[TBD] Press the DRAGON button at the bottom right to open the dragon window.
[TBD] Open the BABY DRAGON tab. Eggs and hatchlings are kept here.
[TBD] Eggs you receive are held in this list.
[TBD] Each shows days left. Close the window and let a day pass.
[TBD] Close the window.
[TBD] That is all for today. The rest of the day is yours.
[TBD] Press NEXT NIGHT once you have built up for the night.
[TBD] Press the WORK MODE button.
[TBD] Each building now shows its workers and capacity.
[TBD] Left click a building to assign one worker.
[TBD] Right click the same building to pull one worker back.
[TBD] Shift-click moves up to capacity, Ctrl-click moves five.
[TBD] Left click still assigns, right click still withdraws.
[TBD] Press ESC, or the WORK MODE button again, to leave this mode.
[TBD] Morning has come. Every night ends with the day being settled.
[TBD] Your people have eaten their food.
[TBD] The research points your lab gathered last night have arrived.
[TBD] The expedition arrived. The land is yours.
[TBD] Your egg has hatched.
[TBD] Press the DRAGON button to open the dragon window.
[TBD] Open the BABY DRAGON tab.
[TBD] The hatchling has joined this list of baby dragons.
[TBD] A baby dragon only eats slimes of its own attribute.
[TBD] The list shows which slime and how much per day.
[TBD] Click the baby dragon to start placing it.
[TBD] Click a green tile to set the baby dragon down.
[TBD] Click the baby dragon you just placed.
[TBD] Here you see its condition and the effect it gives.
[TBD] This tells you whether the baby dragon is currently doing its job.
[TBD] The slimes it eats each day, and how many.
[TBD] How far its effect reaches. Buildings inside this range benefit from it.
[TBD] How strong that effect is for buildings within range.
[TBD] A hungry baby dragon loses its effect and stops working.
[TBD] More dragons eat more. Keep only as many as you can feed.
[TBD] Press the SKILL TREE button.
[TBD] Resources unlock skills here. Close the window.
[TBD] Press RELOCATE and move the baby dragon somewhere else.
[TBD] Click the baby dragon again in its new spot.
[TBD] Press DEMOLISH to take the baby dragon back from this tile.
[TBD] Press the DRAGON button to open the window.
[TBD] Set the baby dragon down again wherever you want it.
[TBD] The slimes your baby dragons eat come from slime farms.
[TBD] Press the BUILD MODE button.
[TBD] Open the FACTORY tab.
[TBD] Pick the slime farm.
[TBD] Click a green tile to build the slime farm.
[TBD] Click the slime farm you just built.
[TBD] The terrain you build on decides which slime you get.
[TBD] Need a certain attribute? Claim that land first.
[TBD] Assign workers. The more you put in, the more slimes it yields.
[TBD] Press CLOSE to close the staffing panel.
[TBD] There is a mode that handles nothing but workers.
[TBD] Click the lab you built yesterday.
[TBD] These are last night's research points.
[TBD] Press CLOSE to close the staffing panel.
[TBD] Press the RESEARCH button to open the research window.
[TBD] Choose one research from the lowest tier and unlock it.
[TBD] Higher tiers open later. Choose what to take first.
[TBD] Close the research window.
[TBD] Click the main castle at the centre.
[TBD] This is the mother dragon's current attribute.
[TBD] It decides her night skills and the effect she lends.
[TBD] Pick another attribute and press CHANGE ATTRIBUTE.
[TBD] Only once a day, so decide by what the night brings.
[TBD] On the right is the mother dragon's skill tree.
[TBD] Only her current branch is open; change it and it shifts.
[TBD] Close the window.
[TBD] You can also open this with the DRAGON button.
[TBD] More monsters tonight. Press NEXT NIGHT when ready.
[TBD] The portals are shaking hard. What comes tonight is not what came before.
[TBD] Tonight they come from three sides, with a boss behind.
[TBD] You cannot hold this with the strength you have.
[TBD] Use the rest of the day, then press NEXT NIGHT.
[TBD] The castle has fallen. Where the fires died down, nothing remains.
[TBD] Then a vast shadow settles over the ruins. The dragon of time.
[TBD] "This was not a night that had to come yet."
[TBD] "Go back. Build it differently this time."
